sources.title: Autotrust JEV-9B Vision Model: Claims vs. Verified Facts
sources.snippet: AutoTrust AI Lab released a vision update to its open JEV-9B model on October 3, 2026, according to the model's Hugging Face repository. The model card publishes specific performance figures for computer use and robotic arm tasks, and explicitly frames the model as a fast visual judge rather than an end-to-end controller, a distinction the card itself flags as important. agentic-ai open-source ...

sources.title: Open-Jev Released: Open-Source 2B/9B Decision… · AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: Zefan Cai's team open-sourced Open-Jev, a pair of open-source decision models (2B and 9B) inspired by the Jev paper. They ship as LoRA adapters plus decision heads, with code, training data, model weights, and a demo video all publicly available.
